item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00760","case1_error":"Substitutes one Monday count for the two Tuesday tile counts, giving 1 + 3 instead of Tuesday-only counts.","case2_error":"Compares interest earnings instead of final balances, omitting both initial investments.","reason":"The first mixes days and substitutes an incorrect count; the second answers the difference in earnings rather than total holdings.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00761","case1_error":"Omits the required $20 flat fee from the total deposit.","case2_error":"Adds the senior discount back after correctly subtracting it, undoing the discount.","reason":"Omitting a required charge differs from explicitly reversing a correctly applied discount.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00762","case1_error":"Incorrectly replaces O = 0.25T with O = 0.25(T − 72), then claims O = 2 from O = 0.25O.","case2_error":"Divides by servings per batch twice, treating the correctly calculated 15 batches as 15 servings.","reason":"The first changes the percentage base and makes an invalid algebraic inference; the second repeats an already completed servings-to-batches conversion.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00763","case1_error":"Omits the initial 50-yard width, equating width increase to the full target width of 80 yards.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written sum 8 + 6 + 12 + 24 as 40 instead of 50.","reason":"The first uses an erroneous width relation; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct distance expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00764","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as 90 seconds for the whole cat, omitting the second ear.","case2_error":"Uses four 30-minute intervals per hour instead of two, doubling the article count.","reason":"The first fails to multiply a per-ear duration by the number of ears; the second uses an incorrect time-conversion factor.","judgment":"different"}]}
